Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Virtual onsite — compact run order, scribe assignment, and candidate preflight

Hi Edison —

Thanks again for taking the next step with Redwood. We’d like to run a compact virtual full-loop on Friday 11/12 (Pacific) and want to confirm two windows that keep panels tight and leave a short buffer for debriefs. Proposed run order below; please confirm which window works for you.

Option A (preferred):
- 09:00–09:30 — System design with Mateo (eng)
- 09:45–10:15 — Product/metrics case with Marissa (pm)
- 10:30–11:00 — Culture + leadership conversation with Karthik (mgr)
- 11:15–11:45 — 20-min debrief and Q&A (panel + you)

Option B (fallback):
- 13:00–13:30 — System design (Mateo)
- 13:45–14:15 — Product (Marissa)
- 14:30–15:00 — Leadership (Karthik)
- 15:15–15:45 — Debrief + Q&A

A few operational notes:
- We’ll assign a scribe for feedback capture; Marissa, can you take scribe for Option A? If not, I’ll assign someone else.
- Please attach an updated resume if anything changed. I’ve also attached the compact runbook (high level) and the candidate prep doc.
- We’ll send an explicit calendar invite with a short prep doc and a Zoom link once we lock the window.

If neither window works, send two alternatives and we’ll reflow. Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can lock panel availability.

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett | Recruiting Lead, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
